releaseNotes.zh-CN:
- 新增按应用设置语言与时区，两项均可单独设置或跟随系统。
- 新增 503 项地区模板，覆盖 247 个国家和地区，支持按中英文地区、城市、语言代码与时区搜索并读取。
- 改善目标应用日志显示，便于确认设置是否生效。
releaseNotes.en:
- Added per-app language and time zone settings, with independent options to follow the system.
- Added 503 regional templates covering 247 countries and territories, searchable by Chinese or English place names, language codes, and time zones.
- Improved target-app logs to make it easier to confirm that settings are applied.
